preconditions.description: The number of tasks N is between 1 and 10,000 inclusive.
The number of prerequisite pairs P is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.
The prerequisites list contains exactly P pairs.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= u < N and 0 <= v < N for u, v in prerequisites)
preconditions.description: Each prerequisite pair [u, v] contains valid task indices between 0 and N-1.

postconditions.description: The function returns True if and only if the directed graph formed by tasks and prerequisites contains no cycles, meaning all tasks can be completed.
